cs.t: > soldering iron and supplies  While I don't own one, the TS100 [0] is supposed to be an amazing soldering iron. [1] As a plus, the hardware and software are open source. [2]  > "helping hands"  Realacc six arm third hand. [3] It's fantastic for the price.  > misc parts/supplies like wire, breadboards, switches, LEDs etc.  AliExpress? YMMV for quality though  > batteries, USB chargers, couple of PC power supplies for power supply  Can't recommend batteries or USB chargers from China, too much counterfeit junk. For PC power supplies, Seasonic is a well priced, quality brand. There are a bunch of ATX power switches available (e.g. AntMiner) on eBay for a few dollars.
